NVIDIA recorded a **$4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal 2026** for H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations【Doc 2】【Doc 5】.  

For the full fiscal year 2026, NVIDIA’s inventory provisions totaled **$7.2 billion**【Doc 1】. This amount includes the $4.5 billion H20 charge and an additional **$2.7 billion** for other excess inventory and purchase obligations.
